meta.name: happyhorse
meta.description: Generate and edit videos with Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via inference.sh CLI. Models: HappyHorse T2V, I2V, R2V, Video Edit. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing with natural language, character preservation, 720P/1080P, up to 15 seconds. Use for: physically realistic video, video editing, character-consistent content, product demos, social media. Triggers: happyhorse, happy horse, alibaba video, happyhorse 1.0, dashscope video, alibaba happyhorse, video editing ai, ai video editor

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成并编辑视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量视频用于社交媒体或产品展示。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit videos with text or images.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create high-quality videos for social media or product demos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行调用阿里 HappyHorse 1.0 模型生成和编辑视频，支持文字转视频、图片转视频、参考图保持角色、自然语言编辑视频，输出 720P/1080P，最长 15 秒。
howto.when: 当你提到“happyhorse”、“阿里视频”、“视频编辑 AI”等关键词，或要求生成/编辑视频时触发。

say.text: 用文字生成一段马在草地上奔跑的视频，10秒，1080P。
say.note: 调用 T2V 模型生成视频。

say.text: 把这张图片变成视频，镜头缓慢推进。
say.note: 调用 I2V 模型动画化图片。

say.text: 编辑这个视频，把背景换成雪景。
say.note: 调用 Video Edit 模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate and edit videos using Alibaba HappyHorse 1.0 models via CLI, supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, and video editing with natural language, outputting 720P/1080P up to 15 seconds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "happyhorse", "Alibaba video", "video editing AI", or ask to generate/edit a video.

say_en.text: Generate a video of a horse galloping in a meadow, 10 seconds, 1080P.
Animate this image with a gentle camera zoom.
Edit this video to change the background to a snowy landscape.
